title: Develop a Full MERN Application using React, Express, Node and MongoDB
requirements: Three-Tier MERN Architecture Integration (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)
Express REST API Gateway & Mongoose ODM Data Modeling
React Single Page Application with React Router v6 & Custom Hooks
Unified Client-to-Server Fetch API Service with JWT Authentication
End-to-End Catalogue Search, Filter, Book Details, and Rental Workflows
Reader Registration, Login, Protected Dashboard & UPI Subscription Management
implemented: Integrated three-tier MERN stack architecture connecting React 18 SPA, Node.js runtime, Express REST API, and MongoDB with Mongoose ODM.
Unified client-side fetch service with automatic JWT Bearer token attachment and centralized JSON parsing.
Asynchronous data flow synchronizing React Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext) with backend REST endpoints for catalogue, membership, and rental operations.
Secure end-to-end user authentication with bcrypt password hashing in MongoDB, signed JWT tokens, and React protected route guards.
